source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)

filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:Nextdoor OR "neighbourhood platforms" OR "neighborhood platforms" OR "neighbourhood apps" OR "neighborhood apps",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)

  and title-abstract has ("Nextdoor" OR "neighborhood apps" OR "neighborhood platforms" OR "neighbourhood apps" OR "neighbourhood platforms")
